Which of the following is equivalent to ∫Cydx+xdy+z2dz, where C is a portion of the helix r(t)=cos⁡ti+sin⁡tj+tk for t∈[0,2π]?

a
∫02πcos⁡t+sin⁡t+tdt
b
∫02πcos⁡2t+t2dt
c
∫02πcos⁡t+tdt
d
∫02πcos⁡t−sin⁡t+t2dt
e
∫02π1+t2dt
